edges.reason: depositByContract pulls tokens from msg.sender and gates on isTrustedDepositContract[msg.sender].
stake credits msg.sender and reads tokens from msg.sender.
unstake operates on msg.sender balances and transfers tokens to msg.sender.
reInvest accrues and re-stakes msg.sender rewards.
Constructor sets contractStartTime and adminClaimableTime from now.
getPendingDivs reward math depends directly on block.timestamp.
noContractsAllowed requires tx.origin == msg.sender in stake.
noContractsAllowed requires tx.origin == msg.sender in unstake.
noContractsAllowed requires tx.origin == msg.sender in claim.
noContractsAllowed requires tx.origin == msg.sender in reInvest.
doSwap reads TRUSTED_DEPOSIT_TOKEN_ADDRESS as swap output token.
reInvest adds swapped TRUSTED_DEPOSIT_TOKEN_ADDRESS to stake.
doSwap uses TRUSTED_REWARD_TOKEN_ADDRESS as swap input token.
updateAccount slices referral fee with REFERRAL_FEE_RATE_X_100.
unstake does not check isEmergency but the flag governs contract behavior.
unstake removes msg.sender from holders when balance hits zero.
updateAccount accrues rewards based on depositedTokens.
unstake decrements depositedTokens after transferring out.
unstake reads stakingTime for lockup check.
claim reads and zeroes rewardsPendingClaim then swaps.
reInvest reads and zeroes rewardsPendingClaim then swaps.
updateAccount reads referrals[account] to pay referral fee.
unstake reads referrals[msg.sender] to clean referred sets.
doSwap calls the Uniswap router swapExactTokensForTokens.
doSwap calls IERC20.balanceOf before and after the swap.
transferReferralFeeIfPossible uses safeTransfer to the referrer.
depositByContract uses safeTransferFrom to pull tokens.
stake calls updateAccount before crediting the new stake.
stake uses safeTransferFrom and safeTransfer for fee.
unstake transfers tokens to msg.sender before decrementing depositedTokens.
claim calls doSwap to convert rewards.
claim performs external swap and token transfer while using caller-supplied slippage params.
reInvest calls doSwap to convert rewards.
reInvest performs external swap and token accounting with caller-supplied slippage params.
claimAnyToken uses safeTransfer to move ERC20 tokens.
External token transfer can reenter unstake before depositedTokens is decremented.
External token transfer/swap can reenter claim.
External token transfer/swap can reenter reInvest.
Router swap is an external call reachable from the unstake path via updateAccount referral fees.
amountToStake drives stake accounting and fee computation.
_amountOutMin_referralFee is forwarded into the referral swap.
_deadline is forwarded to the Uniswap router call.
amountToWithdraw bounds the unstake transfer and balance subtraction.
_amountOutMin_claim is forwarded to the claim swap.
_amountOutMin_reinvest is forwarded to the reinvest swap.
account receives the credited deposit in depositByContract.
amount is pulled and credited in depositByContract.
token selects the asset swept in claimAnyToken.
recipient receives the swept funds in claimAnyToken.
_holder is the account whose pending dividends are computed.
pendingDivs local accumulates rewards inside updateAccount.
referralFee local is subtracted from pending dividends in updateAccount.
platformTokenReceived is transferred to the referrer.
timeDiff local feeds the reward formula in getPendingDivs.
stakedAmount local feeds the reward formula in getPendingDivs.
toTokenReceived local is returned by doSwap.
success local determines whether the referral fee was actually paid.
